plainText:
Togepi's Determination (Japanese: トゲピーの重大決心 's Serious Determination) is the eighty-fifth chapter of the Pokémon Pocket Monsters manga.

==Plot==
 
While still at Goldenrod City, Red meets the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman of Johto. The Chairman notices Red's Togepi and is interested in having it. With Togepi having a new training partner, will this be goodbye for Togepi?
